capabilities.rationale: Local registration, verification, password sign-in, profile editing, session rotation, and sign-out are required by the supplied tasks.
Local password recovery uses indistinguishable public responses and the generated WebsiteBench auth runtime.
Registration and password-reset verification use the HackerRank-branded local-only outbox. No provider is called.
Coding practice creates no order analogue.
No subscription or purchase flow is in scope.
The app exposes no payment surface. The runtime keeps local-sandbox as an inert default.
Accounts, sessions, profiles, saved challenges, editor drafts, runs, submissions, progress, badges, and settings require one site-bound SQLite database.
